meta.name: gotiny.ai
meta.description: Design DNA for the gotiny.ai marketing site, distilled from the shared visual language of elevenlabs.io and fish.audio. Visual-reproduction mode per references/design-dna.md: style is inherited, nothing is copied — no markup, CSS, assets, wordmarks or copy from either site.
meta.source_references: elevenlabs.io (2026-09-11), fish.audio (2026-09-11) — see RECON/*.json for the measurements behind every number here

primary.role: near-black — body text and the primary button fill. Both references use near-black on warm off-white, never a coloured primary

secondary.role: warm recessed panel that the demo card sits on (11L #F5F3F1, fish #F4EEEB)

accent.role: used sparingly — links, active state, focus ring. fish.audio's teal; 11L uses no chromatic accent at all, so accent area stays under ~2% of the page

neutral.scale: warm gray, hue held near 60-70 in oklch: #FDFCFC → #F5F2EE → #EBE8E4 → #A59F97 → #776F6A → #44403B → #0A0A0B
neutral.usage: the entire surface and text ramp; separation is by background tone, not by shadow

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant — near-black text on warm off-white, one near-black inverted block for the closing CTA

font_families.heading: Inter Variable at weight 300 (both references pay for a bespoke display face — Waldenburg, Onest. Inter Light is the closest honest stand-in until gotiny licenses one)
font_families.mono: ui-monospace / Geist Mono — both references use a mono for code and IDs

typography.font_style_notes: The signature both sites share and most imitations miss: display type is LIGHT (300-400), never bold, and body text carries slightly POSITIVE tracking (+0.01em at 14-16px) while only display goes negative (-0.02em). Line-height is generous: 1.47-1.6 on body, 1.06-1.17 on display.

spacing.section_rhythm: 96-128px vertical between major sections; 20-24px inside cards; hero runs ~80px above the fold content and ~112px below

layout.grid_system: single centred container, 12-col mental model, no visible grid
layout.max_content_width: 1152px (11L measured 1144px, fish 1172px — 1152 sits between and is a clean 72rem)
layout.columns: hero is 2-col asymmetric (headline ~55%, supporting paragraph ~40% offset right); feature grids 2-col and 4-col
layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric — BOTH references left-align the hero headline and float the paragraph right rather than centring. This is the single biggest structural tell of the genre.

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px — hairline warm gray (#E5E2DE), used constantly for separation instead of shadow
shape.divider_style: 1px hairline at the same warm gray; full-bleed between sections

levels.high: 0 24px 48px -24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12) reserved for the hero demo card only

elevation.depth_cues: colour intensity and overlapping layers — a card is white on a warm panel, not a floating box

iconography.preferred_set: hand-drawn inline SVG; no icon dependency

motion.easing: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for state changes (both sites' dominant curve); cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for entrances (fish.audio's)
motion.entrance_pattern: short fade + 12px rise, staggered ~60ms down the hero

components.button_style: PILL (9999px) — 167 occurrences on 11L, 54 on fish. Primary is near-black fill, white text, 15-16px at weight 400 (NOT semibold), ~16px horizontal padding, ~40px tall. Secondary is a hairline-bordered ghost pill.
components.input_style: 12px radius, hairline border, white fill, generous 12-16px padding
components.card_style: white on a warm recessed panel, 12px radius for small cards and 24px for the hero demo card, hairline border, little or no shadow
components.navigation_pattern: sticky, transparent until scrolled then hairline border + blur; logo left, links centre-left, sign-in + pill CTA right
components.modal_style: centred, 16px radius, dim overlay at ~28% near-black
components.component_notes: Both sites make the interactive product demo the hero's visual anchor — a large card immediately under the headline, not a screenshot further down the page.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a quiet studio — paper-warm surfaces, instruments laid out neatly
aesthetic.era_influence: post-2023 Swiss-influenced SaaS; warm neutrals rather than the cool grays of 2020

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous and load-bearing — whitespace does the work shadows would
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: top-heavy: hero headline and demo card carry the page, everything below is quieter
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element — the demo card
visual_language.contrast_level: high on text (near-black on off-white), very low on chrome (hairlines, warm panels)
visual_language.texture_usage: fish.audio uses a painterly gradient behind the demo; 11L uses flat warm panels. Both avoid noise and glass.

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast and spatial isolation, not weight — headings are LIGHTER than body in 11L's case
composition.flow_direction: left-to-right down a single column of full-bleed bands
composition.grouping_strategy: full-bleed bands alternating background tone; hairline borders between
composition.negative_space_role: primary — it is what makes the type feel expensive

imagery.photo_treatment: none — neither site uses photography above the fold
imagery.illustration_style: abstract gradient orbs (11L) / painterly gradient wash (fish)

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate, quiet — colour and border shifts, no bounce
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: background tint or border darkening at 150ms; pills lift slightly
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: low — reserved for the demo player

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: state plainly what is missing and the one command that fixes it

overview.fallback_strategy: everything degrades to flat colour; prefers-reduced-motion kills all animation

background_effects.description: A soft warm radial wash behind the hero and the closing CTA. fish.audio does this with a painterly raster; we do it with a CSS radial-gradient so nothing is downloaded and it retints per theme.

params.color_palette: accent at 6-10% over the warm ground
params.density: single 60% x 60% ellipse at top centre

text_effects.description: Neither reference animates its headline. The motion budget goes to the demo player.

canvas_drawings.description: The waveform is DOM spans, not canvas — 72 elements is cheaper than a render loop and it inherits the theme tokens for free. Neither reference uses canvas on its homepage (measured: 0 canvases on both).

visual_effects.composite_notes: Both references are measurably restrained: zero canvas, no WebGL, no particles, no cursor effects, no parallax. The genre reads premium because of type, warm neutrals and whitespace — not effects. Do not add any.
